note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 3 homes for sale in Finland, each one checked by a person.
In Finland, the median asking price of those 3 homes is €49,000 (€400 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €48,000 and the most expensive €134,000.
With 3 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Finland is a rough guide.

homes.title: Spacious 4-bedroom detached house with plot, sauna and garage in Aavasaksa, Lapland
homes.title_es: Amplia casa independiente de 4 dormitorios con parcela, sauna y garaje en Aavasaksa, Laponia
homes.summary: This two-storey detached house in Aavasaksa sits on a 3,509 m² plot. The ground floor has two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom, a windowed sauna, a porch and two separate toilets, while the upper floor has two bedrooms, a hall area, one separate toilet and two storage rooms. The yard offers room for children's play, gardening or hobbies, and includes a large storage building connected to a garage, a smaller storage building and an outdoor sauna. The living area is 143 m². Asking €49,000, about €343/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom bungalow with garden, terrace and fireplace in Juoksenki, Lapland
homes.title_es: Bungalow de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y chimenea en Juoksenki, Laponia
homes.summary: This one-story bungalow in Juoksenki, Lapland, has about 120 m2 of living space. It has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen with space for a dining table, a utility room, a bathroom, a separate toilet and a private sauna. The 1085 m2 plot has a garden, a terrace and a separate storage room. An atmospheric fireplace and an air-source heat pump provide heating. The Tornionjoki River is about 150 meters away and the shop about 500 meters. Asking €48,000, about €400/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom wooden house with terrace and garden in Valkeakoski, Pirkanmaa
homes.title_es: Casa de madera renovada de 4 dormitorios con terraza y jardín en Valkeakoski, Pirkanmaa
homes.summary: This renovated wooden house, completed in 1948, sits in the Laiska residential area. It has six rooms, four of them bedrooms, two bathrooms and two separate toilets. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, a private 1069 square metre plot with a garden, a fireplace, a cellar and a separate garage. An air heat pump provides heating, and fibre-optic internet is available. City services are easily reachable from this peaceful setting. Asking €134,000, about €893/m².
